string.text: Barrel adjustment
Allows you to reduce the spread of bullets when firing a weapon, which increases the accuracy and accuracy of fire.
Re-rifling the barrel
Changing the pitch of the rifling in the bore of a weapon allows you to increase the initial speed of the bullet and reduce the spread of hits when firing.
Barrel with silencer mount
Installing a barrel from an APB pistol allows you to install an appropriate silent shooting device on the weapon.
Modification of the magazine latch
Reduces magazine play inside the weapon handle, facilitating trouble-free feeding of cartridges from the magazine to the chamber.
Retarder modification
Modification of the retarder, coupled with the installation of a stiffer mainspring, makes it possible to increase the rate of fire of the weapon.
Lightweight store
Replacing a standard magazine with a lightweight modern analogue allows you to slightly reduce the weight of the weapon.
Forcing USM
Reconfiguring the trigger and modifying some of its parts allows the shooter to fire at a higher rate.Unfortunately, this causes the weapon to wear out a little faster.
Auto cut-off

Installing an automatic cut-off mechanism limits the maximum burst length to three bullets.In this automatic fire mode, it is much easier to control the weapon, which significantly reduces the consumption of ammunition required to hit each individual target.
Anatomical pad

Handle overlay, created taking into account the individual characteristics and preferences of the shooter.Thanks to the pad, the grip of the weapon becomes much more convenient, and shooting - more comfortable.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Soft trigger trigger
Allows you to reduce recoil, facilitating more accurate shooting.
Refinement of the extractor
Allows you to reduce the number of delays associated with the sticking of cartridges ejected from the pistol after firing.It has a beneficial effect on the reliability of the weapon.
Improved bore locking mechanism
By locking the bore more tightly, the obturation of the bore improves and the muzzle velocity of the bullet increases.
Shutter Balancing
Balancing the bolt group parts reduces the barrel moving away from the line of sight when firing and reduces felt recoil.
Protective coating
Applying a special coating to weapon parts can significantly slow down its wear.
Adjusting the bolt mechanism
Precise fitting of the bolt mechanism elements reduces backlash and allows for higher shooting accuracy.
Lightweight parts
Replacing standard weapon parts with lightweight analogues made from modern alloys makes it possible to reduce the weight of weapons.
Heavy Duty Parts
New parts made from modern refractory alloys have higher strength, which slows down the wear of the weapon and has a beneficial effect on its reliability.
